description: Runs one read (GET) operation of The Deployer's app as the person: domains, scaling, schedules, databases and other cloud services, app access, environments, blueprints, servers and more. Changes nothing. Secrets are never returned. Documented at https://portal.thedploy.com/docs.

path.description: The operation's path with ids filled in, e.g. /projects/12/scaling

workspace.description: A teammate's workspace id. Default: your own.

name: api_read
title: Read an operation's answer
